description: One owner item (contract 05, frozen at S6). A surfaced wait becomes exactly one owner item; the item carries the served verb set its decision is validated against at the tap (ATT2), the decision subrecord and its history, and the fulfillment kind from which fulfillment is derived — never assumed. Id scheme (ATT5): handle:source_ref.

decision.description: The standing decision, or null while undecided.

decision_history.description: Past decisions that failed or stalled and returned the item to the queue, with the outcome on the item's face.

failure.description: Visible failure text when a failed or stalled decision has returned this item to the queue.

fulfillment.description: How fulfillment is derived: from the send ledger (send), from the scripted push-fact measurement (push_needed), or recorded with no send minted (recorded).

options.description: The decision options when the served verb set carries `decide`; null otherwise.

verbs.description: The served verb set for this item; a decision verb is validated against it at the tap (ATT2).

title: Owner item (contract 05)
